paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 86a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.86a.3); he posed a difficulty to Ravina.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage names Huna son of Mar Zutra asking Ravina why fixing a price matters once merchandise has been unloaded. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=980&lang=en) cites their exchange.
